R-01 · Reflections 03 of 06

A vertical reflective form emerges from a dark field, its surface bending and distorting surrounding space. A floating element above reinforces instability. The patterned ground subtly shifts, preventing spatial resolution and maintaining a continuous tension between form, field, and perception.
